title: Iberico Ham and Pretzel Tart
description: A French-inspired savory tart featuring the rich flavors of Iberico ham and crunchy pretzels.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the crushed pretzels evenly over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the pretzels with the sliced Iberico ham and jamón (if using).
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the pastry with the beaten egg and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
